blockers.problem: The guide omits the Dossier’s warning that an organization will not appear under Resource owner when it blocks fine-grained personal access tokens.
blockers.suggestion: After step 4, state that an organization will not appear if it blocks fine-grained personal access tokens, so the reader knows why the required owner may be unavailable.

blockers.where: external.md#generate-personal-access-token — “wait for an organization administrator to approve it”
blockers.problem: A reader whose token is pending is not told where the approver must go or which controls complete the approval required before first connection.
blockers.suggestion: Research GitHub’s documented pending-token approval path, record the exact navigation and controls in the Research Dossier, and render either those steps or a precise handoff to the approver in external.md.

nits.problem: The Dossier attributes catalog-only selection solely to Pulse presence even though Metadata records the operator’s forced `speakeasy_add_server: catalog` override.
nits.suggestion: Record that `speakeasy_add_server: catalog` forces the catalog-only path, with the matched Pulse entry as corroborating provenance.

nits.where: external.md#configure-token-access — “grant the minimum repository, organization, and account permissions for the operations supplied by the application owner”
nits.problem: The reader must translate requested operations into GitHub permission names and access levels without being told to obtain those exact selections from the application owner.
nits.suggestion: Record and render a hedge directing the reader to obtain the exact GitHub permission names and access levels from the application owner before completing the Permissions section.
